summary: The final candidate improves forward body travel in 3 of 4 trials and completes one physical diagonal-pair step in one reduced-strength trial. Body tilt remains 1.12–1.36 degrees RMS with no falls. It still fails all four complete-walking trials, with inconsistent rear-left lift, reduced simultaneous clearance and excessive sideways drift in two conditions.
decision: Keep as an experimental continuation checkpoint, not a replacement for the previous gait. Preserve the previous checkpoint and show both in the review video. Further work must address unloading and lifting the weaker diagonal before more forward-travel reward.
training_r1: Stopped early after update 508 due to paired-clearance regression; checkpoint 500 retained.
training_r2: Completed 250 additional updates, iterations 300–549, with fresh optimizer and V25 actor/critic initialization.
